To enter the Electrical Engineering degree (BEng) at BCIT as an ECET diploma graduate, applicants generally need a minimum average of 70%. 

* **General ECET Diploma Graduates:** Applicants who have completed an ECET diploma (any option) require a minimum average of 70% to meet the Step 1 entrance requirements.

* **Alternative BCIT Diplomas:** A minimum average of 70% is also required for graduates of the Mechatronics and Robotics diploma or the Biomedical Engineering Technology diploma (though biomedical graduates require an additional, pre-approved physics course). Alternatively, students completing all ECET first-year diploma courses require a minimum average of 75%.

cases.question: If BCIT grants me transfer credit for a course, does my program tuition go down, and how must transcripts be submitted?
cases.standalone_question: If BCIT grants me transfer credit for a course, does my program tuition go down, and how must transcripts be submitted?
cases.answer_excerpt:
When BCIT grants course credit for a full-time program, your program tuition is not reduced, but your course load becomes lighter. To request transfer credit, your official transcripts must be sent directly to BCIT from your previous institution(s) or dropped off in a sealed, stamped envelope; scanned transcripts are not accepted.

* **Tuition Impact:** If you receive individual course credit in a full-time program, the tuition is generally not reduced, though you will carry a lighter course load. 
* **Transcript Submission for Transfer Credit:** Official transcripts must be sent directly from the previously attended institution(s) to BCIT, or dropped off in person in an original sealed and stamped envelope. Unofficial documents, online scans, or uploading scans with your application are not accepted for transfer credit evaluations.

- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/full-time-studies/

cases.question: money back if i withdraw after classes start?
cases.standalone_question: What is the BCIT refund policy or money back eligibility if I withdraw from a course or program after classes start?
cases.answer_excerpt:
You may be eligible for a tuition refund if you withdraw after classes start, provided you do so by the specific program or course refund deadline. 

* **Full-time programs:** For most full-time programs, your latest acceptable withdrawal date to receive a refund is 10 business days after the start of class. Commitment fees are non-refundable and will be deducted from your refund (for example, $500 for domestic degree and technology students, and $6,000 for international students).
* **Flexible Learning (Part-time Studies) courses:** Refund eligibility depends on the course format and length. For classroom-based, blended, or synchronous courses longer than four weeks, the deadline for an 85% tuition refund is prior to the second class. For asynchronous distance/online courses longer than four weeks, the deadline for an 85% refund is within two weeks of the course start date. Continual entry courses lasting more than two weeks allow a 100% refund within two weeks of registration or the course start date.
* **Apprenticeship programs:** Refunds depend on how far in advance you cancel prior to the class start date. No refunds are issued for withdrawals occurring 9 days or less before the start of class, or after the third day of class.

Sources
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/refunds-withdrawals/
sub_queries: BCIT refund policy for course or program withdrawal after classes start

cases.question: BCIT 간호 프로그램 입학하려면 뭐가 필요해?
cases.standalone_question: What are the admission requirements for the Nursing program at BCIT?
cases.answer_excerpt:
BCIT의 정규(Full-time) 간호 학사(Bachelor of Science in Nursing, BSN) 프로그램에 입학하기 위해서는 경쟁 입학 절차에 따라 요구되는 학력 요건 및 서류를 충족해야 합니다.

* **영어 능력 요건:** Category 2에 해당하는 과목(예: English Studies 12 67% 이상 또는 동등한 수준)을 충족해야 합니다.
* **수학 요건:** Pre-Calculus 11 (73%), Pre-Calculus 12 (67%), Foundations of Math 11 (73%), Foundations of Math 12 (73%), 기타 허용되는 BC/Yukon 과목 또는 MATH 0007 (73%) 중 하나를 충족해야 합니다.
* **과학 요건:** Chemistry 11 (73%) 이상을 충족해야 합니다.
* **학업 기초(Academic Foundations) 18.0 학점:** 각 과목당 최소 67% 이상의 성적으로 다음 과정을 이수해야 합니다.
  * ENGL 1177 (Academic Writing) 또는 동등한 과목 3.0 학점 (영어 능력 충족에도 사용 가능)
  * 최근 3년 이내에 이수한 BHSC 1200 (Human Anatomy and Physiology) 또는 동등한 과목 6.0 학점
  * PSYC 1101 (Introductory Psychology 1) 또는 동등한 과목 3.0 학점
  * 최소 100 레벨 이상의 서로 다른 두 학문 분야에서 이수한 일반 교양(General Education) 선택 과목 6.0 학점
* **필수 서류 제출:** 온라인 지원 시 'Mandatory Applicant Questionnaire' 양식을 작성하여 제출해야 합니다.

이후 조건부 합격자로 선정될 경우, 범죄 경력 조회(Criminal Record Check) 및 예방접종 기록(Immunization Records) 등의 추가 요건을 제출해야 최종 합격을 완료할 수 있습니다.
